name: Should I install a new tub or convert it to a shower?

mainEntity.name: Should I install a new tub or convert it to a shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you are comparing tub replacement with a tub-to-shower conversion, think about who uses the bathroom, how much maintenance you want, and how long you plan to stay in the home. A new tub makes sense if you still want bathing space or are keeping the home family-friendly. A conversion may be better if accessibility, easier cleaning, or more open shower space matters more.
acceptedAnswer.description: Install a new tub if you want bathing space or family use. Choose a shower conversion if accessibility, easier cleaning, or open floor space matters more.
